capabilities: Cycle line types with Tab and Shift+Tab
Show a badge naming the current line type
Set line types and renumber scenes from the command palette
Export notes to docx, PDF, HTML and txt
extras: Not yet in the community catalog; install manually or through BRAT. Export to Word, HTML and txt needs pandoc, while PDF uses Obsidian's built-in exporter. The English interface has not been checked in the app yet.
intentEvidence: Most screenplay plugins render their own format (Fountain and friends), and the document turns into a pile of symbols
motivation: Most screenplay plugins render their own format (Fountain and friends), turning the document into a pile of symbols outside the plugin; this one keeps the document as ordinary Markdown.
problem: Screenplay plugins that use their own format leave the document full of symbols once it leaves the plugin, so the file is no longer readable Markdown.

relations.evidence: Most screenplay plugins render their own format (Fountain and friends), and the document turns into a pile of symbols
Everything except PDF uses pandoc — set its path in the plugin settings.
Add this repository through BRAT while the plugin is not in the community catalog yet.

summary: Screenplay writing workflow that cycles line types with Tab and stores each element as plain Markdown, with import and export.
